inpDir.title: Input directory
inpDir.description: Path to directory containing images or path to a single image.

filePattern.title: Filename pattern
filePattern.description: Filename pattern used to find images.

outImgName.title: Output image name
outImgName.description: Name of the output image. Only needed when input is a directory.

outFormat.title: Output Format
outFormat.description: Output format of the image pyramid.

dsMethod.title: Downsample method
dsMethod.description: Downsample method for generating pyramid. Default to 'mean' for all channels. Specify as a dictionary with channel no as key and method as value. Available methods are 'mean','mode_min', 'mode_max'.

ui.title: Output image name
ui.description: Name of the output image. Only needed when input is a directory.

ui.title: Output Format
ui.description: Output format of the image pyramid.

ui.title: Downsample method
ui.description: Downsample method for generating pyramid. Default to 'mean' for all channels. Specify as a dictionary with channel no as key and method as value. Available methods are 'mean','mode_min', 'mode_max'.
